notes: This portable C++ TCK case publishes the adapter-configured ordinary application attributes, unpublishes one selected attribute through the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API, and queries the current publication state through the standard 1516.2-2025 MIM. The API surface is taken from the official public header; provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, class/attribute names, and MIM module are adapter-supplied. No vendor implementation hooks or DDM region APIs are used by the test scenario.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishObjectClassAttributes( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, AttributeHandleSet const & attributes) = 0
